artipoppe-zeitgeist-baby-carrier: Wide waistband carries weight for hours into toddlerhood; others found it bulky, hot and overpriced.
babybjorn-baby-carrier-mini: Quick for newborns and easy to put on alone; the main downside is back strain, so keep wears short.
babyletto-hudson-3-in-1-convertible-crib: Solid, easy to assemble and long-lasting, reused for a second baby or as a toddler bed.
britax-poplar: Easy installation, good fit in small back seats and long rear-facing use.
britax-poplar-s: Fits small cars yet leaves front-seat room; one found legroom tight in a small hatchback.
bugaboo-butterfly-2: One-hand fold that fits small cars and planes; small wheels catch on tracks, and recline isn't flat.
bugaboo-fox-5-renew: Sturdy and smooth on snow and off-road walks, with a handle that adjusts for height.
bugaboo-giraffe: Easy to adjust and clean, and several still use it for toddlers; one was nearly done by 15 months.
chicco-fit360: One-handed rotating seat makes loading easy, especially for shorter parents; it eats front legroom.
chicco-keyfit-35: Easy to install and often reused for a second child; weight is the main downside as baby grows.
comotomo-baby-bottle: Few parts and room for a hand ease cleaning; some babies refused it, and a few found it tipped.
cybex-gazelle-s: Glides on grass, dirt roads and trails, with big storage; the fold can stick or feel stiff at first.
doona-car-seat-stroller: Pops from car seat to stroller for flights and taxis; heavy as baby grows, with little storage.
ergobaby-embrace: Quick to put on and good for newborns; many outgrow it in months as the fabric lacks support.
ergobaby-evolve-3-in-1-bouncer: Hands-free breaks that adjust as baby grows; some babies lose interest, and one wanted auto bounce.
ergobaby-omni-classic: Comfortable well past the baby stage; newborns often need an insert, and solo fastening is tricky.
eufy-baby-monitor-e21: Clear picture, reliable app and good battery; one unit overheated and sent false cry alerts.
evenflo-shyft-dualride: Detachable wheels and plush seat, chosen over a Doona by several; a couple find it heavy.
graco-extend2fit-3-in-1: Keeps tall kids rear-facing longer and fits smaller cars, comfortable and long-lasting.
graco-turn2me-3-in-1: Rotating seat eases buckling even a fussy child; it only rotates rear-facing and takes room.
ikea-antilop: Cheap, light high chair that wipes clean easily; legs stick out, and the tray is hard to remove.
infant-optics-dxr-8: Simple non-WiFi monitor with no app or subscription; the connection can drop at a distance.
lansinoh-baby-bottles: Breastfed babies took these when others were refused; a couple found the flow too fast.
medela-harmony-manual-breast-pump: Compact, quiet and easy to carry, and several say it empties faster than electric pumps.
medela-sonata-smart: Strong, reliable and rechargeable for exclusive pumpers; a couple note it is big and bulky.
momcozy-air-1: Comfortable, discreet wearable pump with good output; some find it better on the go than at home.
momcozy-m5: Suction empties as well as a Spectra or wall pump; one couldn't keep up after returning to work.
momcozy-s12-pro: Strong suction that several say matches a Spectra; motors failed within months for several.
momcozy-s9-pro: Handy and easy to clean; fit matters, and several report leaks, weak pull or early failure.
momcozy-v1-pro: Quiet on-the-go pump that empties well; one got inflammation after relying on it alone.
nanit-pro: Reliable app and a breathing band for peace of mind; the subscription and price are the gripes.
nuna-mixx-next: Big wheels and suspension cope with gravel and cobblestones; some find it heavy and bulky.
nuna-pipa-rx: Light, easy to install and clicks onto several strollers; one found a poor small-baby fit.
nuna-triv-next: Light, easy-folding single stroller that fits the car well; smaller basket and a less smooth ride.
nuna-trvl: Light travel stroller with a one-handed fold that holds up to hard use; rough on uneven sidewalks.
nuna-trvl-lx: Light, quick one-handed fold and compact for travel and tight spaces; it won't fit an overhead bin.
owlet-dream-sock: Many say it eased anxiety and helped them sleep; others got frequent false alarms.
solly-baby-wrap: Cozy for hours in the newborn months; tricky to wrap right and hot or less useful as baby grows.
spectra-s1-plus: Rechargeable, with suction many say beats wearables; heavy and not discreet.
stokke-clikk: Very easy to clean and assemble, and light for travel; the small tray and wide legs trip people.
stokke-limas-carrier: Adjustable fit and easy buckle; one found it uncomfortable once the baby neared 25 lbs.
uppababy-cruz-v2: Sturdy over uneven surfaces with a big basket; weight and bulk make it hard to fit in a trunk.
uppababy-mesa-v2: Easy to carry, with a good newborn insert and a simple click-in; some babies disliked it.
uppababy-minu-v2: Light, quick one-handed fold that suits frequent flying; small basket, and two hands to open.
uppababy-vista-v2: Sturdy, smooth and capable on snow and cobblestones with a big basket; bulky, and eats trunk space.
